verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents public REST APIs for programmatic control. The resource-management REST APIs offer endpoints to create and manage resources for end-to-end automation, with OpenAPI-compliant specs and Postman collections in an official GitHub repo. The SQL API can submit, check and cancel statements and manage users, roles and tables, and Cortex Analyst is also exposed as a REST API. The probe's 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the specs are published on GitHub. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via these APIs.
